verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands W (Infernal Chains) and all-ins before level 6; you win the lane long-term if you survive to Statikk Shiv and poke him down from range.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's entire kit is built around Q (The Darkin Blade) reset damage and E (Umbral Dash) sustain, both of which only function at melee range, so the matchup is decided by whether Teemo can hold 680-range poke with E (Toxic Shot) and Q (Blinding Dart) without ever entering his dash-chain radius. OP.GG's own data confirms this is a defensive lane for Teemo (51.5% over 2065 games) with Aatrox favored for both lane and solo-kill equity, meaning the burden is on you to disengage correctly, not to win trades outright.

theirWindow.what: He will immediately dash in with E (Umbral Dash) and swing Q (The Darkin Blade) for the chain-pull bonus damage plus his passive Deathbringer Stance proc. Blind him instantly with Q (Blinding Dart) the moment the chain connects to shut off the follow-up auto and reduce the damage of the engage.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no dash available he cannot close distance quickly, so walk up to exactly 680 range, land E (Toxic Shot) autos and Q (Blinding Dart) when it's up, then kite backward. This is your only reliable damage window before level 6.

start.why: 51.9% win rate over 1920 games and 73.3% pick rate; the extra sustain from the health pots lets you hold poke range instead of trading into his Q (The Darkin Blade) swings.

boots.why: 51% win rate over 1396 games and the dominant 56.2% pick; the flat movement speed matters more than magic pen here because your whole win condition is staying outside his E (Umbral Dash) range.

core.why: First item in the 58.5% win rate, 37% pick path; the attack speed and proc damage let you punish any approach without standing still for his Deathbringer Stance passive to reset.
Burn damage scales with his tankiness as he builds HP for R (World Ender) uptime, and it keeps ticking even after you've disengaged.
Completes the 58.5%-win-rate core path; ability haste shortens Q (Blinding Dart) cooldown so you can blind him on cooldown during extended skirmishes.

you are ahead and want to burst through his shield/HP before he can engage

runes.keystoneWhy: The 50.5% win rate, 30.1% pick page; three consecutive hits at range mark him and amplify damage, rewarding poke patterns instead of all-in trades you can't win pre-6.

summoners.why: 92% pick rate and the highest win rate of the three options (50.7%); Ignite denies his Deathbringer Stance and R (World Ender) healing on all-ins, directly countering OP.GG's tip to prioritize anti-heal.

playing.title: Hold exactly 680 range
playing.detail: Both your Q (Blinding Dart) and E (Toxic Shot) cap at 680; stand at that edge so you can poke while staying just outside his W (Infernal Chains) 825 range threat zone timing.

playing.title: Save Q for the chain
playing.detail: Don't waste Q (Blinding Dart) on CS trades. Hold it to blind him the instant W (Infernal Chains) connects, cutting the damage off his guaranteed follow-up auto.

playing.title: Track his Q swing count
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade's cooldown drops from 14s to 6s as he levels it, and each cast can chain up to three swings; back off completely if you see him mid-combo since the AoE grows with each swing.

playing.title: Never trade after R at level 6
playing.detail: R (World Ender) gives him bonus AD, healing, and move speed with a 120s cooldown at rank 1; if he hits 6 before you see his summoners rotate top, play fully passive until it's confirmed used or expired.

playing.title: Punish dash cooldown windows
playing.detail: E (Umbral Dash) is his only gap-closer outside Q's range; its cooldown starts at 9s and drops to 5s at max rank, so count it down and only extend trades when it's clearly unavailable.

playing.title: Itemize anti-heal on schedule
playing.detail: OP.GG's tip is explicit: grab Oblivion Orb components early if he's healing back trades, since both his passive and R scale his sustain the longer the game goes.

playing.title: Shove and reset, don't duel
playing.detail: Use W (Move Quick)'s passive speed to shove waves fast and back off before he can set up Infernal Chains; your lane plan is tempo and poke, not stand-and-fight trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG game data on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid The Darkin Blade (Q)! Purchase items that reduce healing first.
